maddeler.e:
نشتئي (form VIII)
# نَشْتَئِي (naštaʔī) /naʃ.ta.ʔiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَأَى (ištaʔā)
# نَشْتَئِيَ (naštaʔiya) /naʃ.ta.ʔi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَأَى (ištaʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
